summary.content:
Today's selection covers 84 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 56 on Artificial Intelligence and 10 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI encourages firms to trial four-day weeks to adapt to AI era
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: FBI: Americans lost a record $21 billion to cybercrime last year
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 49 articles published in the last 24 hours
